Five sentences have been removed from the text below. For each question, choose the correct answer. There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use.
Ballet for children and teenagers
It can take a long time to reach a professional level in ballet, so most dancers begin their training very young. This is because it is usually more difficult to change old habits than to learn new ones. 16______
The first thing that young children who are interested in learning to dance often do is attend creative movement classes where they can practise simple skills like jumping and turning, and just have fun. 17______ In addition, some people recommend that they should learn either to sing or play an instrument.
Young people who decide they want to have a ballet career can attend a dance school. Here, students not only study normal school subjects but also do daily dance training. 18______ And the whole dance-school environment is set up to support the young people's artistic development, allowing them to focus on their dance more easily and preparing them for their future. But how can a young dancer and their parents tell which dance school is the most suitable? 19______ The older students taking part in it should clearly have more highly-developed ballet skills than the younger dancers.
By the time they are 16 or 17, many ballet dancers are entering ballet competitions and taking classes at professional studios. 20______ It is important for young dancers to know how well they are doing, because the dance world is very competitive and the training is hard; not everyone makes it to the top.

sentences.label: A
sentences.text: For all these reasons, they enjoy meeting other dancers.

sentences.label: B
sentences.text: Listening to different styles of music also helps.

sentences.label: C
sentences.text: Travelling long distances to dance schools can be tiring, too.

sentences.label: D
sentences.text: Attending one of their public performances is a good way of finding out.

sentences.label: E
sentences.text: If they develop poor technique, they may have problems later on.

sentences.label: F
sentences.text: Few people know where to find them.

sentences.label: G
sentences.text: This allows them to compare themselves with teenagers from other schools.

sentences.label: H
sentences.text: That means they do not waste time travelling from home to dance classes.

explanations.16: 芭蕾需从小训练，E选项“If they develop poor technique, they may have problems later on.”（技术差 later 会有问题）说明原因，与“more difficult to change old habits”逻辑衔接。
explanations.17: 建议学唱歌或乐器，B选项“Listening to different styles of music also helps.”（听不同音乐也有帮助）补充音乐相关建议，与“learn either to sing or play an instrument”并列。
explanations.18: 舞蹈学校学生既学文化又训练，H选项“That means they do not waste time travelling from home to dance classes.”（无需往返，节省时间）说明住校优势，与“focus on their dance more easily”呼应。
explanations.19: 如何选择合适舞蹈学校，D选项“Attending one of their public performances is a good way of finding out.”（观看演出是好方法）给出建议，与“older students have more highly-developed skills”衔接。
explanations.20: 16-17岁参加比赛和专业课程，G选项“This allows them to compare themselves with teenagers from other schools.”（与其他学校学生比较）说明比赛作用，与“know how well they are doing”呼应。

article_blocks.text: Five sentences have been removed from the text below. For each question, choose the correct answer. There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use.

Ballet for children and teenagers
It can take a long time to reach a professional level in ballet, so most dancers begin their training very young.
This is because it is usually more difficult to change old habits than to learn new ones.

The first thing that young children who are interested in learning to dance often do is attend creative movement classes where they can practise simple skills like jumping and turning, and just have fun.
In addition, some people recommend that they should learn either to sing or play an instrument.
Young people who decide they want to have a ballet career can attend a dance school.
Here, students not only study normal school subjects but also do daily dance training.
And the whole dance-school environment is set up to support the young people's artistic development, allowing them to focus on their dance more easily and preparing them for their future.
But how can a young dancer and their parents tell which dance school is the most suitable?
The older students taking part in it should clearly have more highly-developed ballet skills than the younger dancers.
By the time they are 16 or 17, many ballet dancers are entering ballet competitions and taking classes at professional studios.
It is important for young dancers to know how well they are doing, because the dance world is very competitive and the training is hard; not everyone makes it to the top.
